description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.dom.document class, which represents and provides utility methods for interacting with a DOM document object within the CKEditor environment. It includes methods to manipulate the document such as adding stylesheets, creating elements and text nodes, retrieving elements by ID or tag, and accessing the document's head, body, and window.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.document
classes.description: Represents and provides utility functions for a DOM document within the CKEditor environment.

methods.name: appendStyleSheet
methods.description: Appends a CSS file to the document by URL.

methods.name: appendStyleText
methods.description: Appends CSS text as a style block to the document.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a new element with optional attributes and styles.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new text node with specified content.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus on the document's window.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an element by its ID.

methods.name: getByAddress
methods.description: Retrieves a node by a specified address in the DOM tree.

methods.name: getElementsByTag
methods.description: Returns elements matching a specified tag name and namespace.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the <head> element of the document.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the <body> element of the document.

methods.name: getDocumentElement
methods.description: Returns the root document element.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object associated with the document.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Replaces document content using document.write.
